ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - PPID Spoofing SelectMyParent Tool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of parent process ID spoofing tools like Didier Stevens tool SelectMyParent

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\SelectMyParent\\\.exe$") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*PPID\\-spoof.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ppid\\_spoof.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*spoof\\-ppid.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*spoof\\_ppid.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ppidspoof.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*spoofppid.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*spoofedppid.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-spawnto\\ .*")) OR (process_original_file_name = RGX(".*PPID\\-spoof.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*ppid\\_spoof.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*spoof\\-ppid.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*spoof\\_ppid.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*ppidspoof.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*spoofppid.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*spoofedppid.*")) OR process_description = "SelectMyParent" OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=04D974875BD225F00902B4CAD9AF3FBC.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=A782AF154C9E743DDF3F3EB2B8F3D16E.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=89059503D7FBF470E68F7E63313DA3AD.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=CA28337632625C8281AB8A130B3D6BAD.*")))
